title: Senior Account Manager - GCC, Digital Transformation
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Account Manager to lead our Global Capability Centers (GCC) business within the Digital Transformation practice. This role is responsible for shaping Arche Global's GCC-focused strategy, driving enterprise transformation initiatives, and building deep customer and partner relationships across global markets. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience working with GCCs, strong understanding of cloud and enterprise technologies, and a proven ability to influence senior leadership stakeholders while driving measurable business outcomes. This is a strategic and high-impact role that requires leadership, vision, and a strong commercial mindset. Roles and Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership • Shape and lead Arche Global's digital transformation and GCC strategy. • Define and implement a long-term customer management approach for global capability center clients. • Collaborate with internal leadership to deliver transformation programs that enhance customer value and operational performance. Customer and Partner Ecosystem Development • Build and strengthen relationships with senior executives across GCCs, global accounts, and key technology partners. • Work closely with partners such as Microsoft, Google, AWS, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, and leading Telco providers. • Establish a strong partner ecosystem to drive joint go-to-market strategies and pipeline growth. • Lead partner cadence and business rhythm to track performance metrics and execution strength. Sales and Business Development • Drive global sales initiatives and support enterprise opportunities across markets. • Own revenue targets for GCC accounts and contribute to team-level business goals. • Identify key opportunities with partners and customers, ensuring solution adoption and customer satisfaction. • Manage complex global customer relationships, engaging with CXO-level decision makers. Operational Excellence • Manage project and program governance to ensure seamless execution of transformation initiatives. • Track key performance indicators such as adoption, solution success, delivery outcomes, and revenue performance. • Ensure alignment of internal and partner resources to strategic objectives. Innovation and Technology • Keep abreast of emerging technologies in cloud, security, networking, and AI-driven transformation. • Drive innovation with partners and customers to introduce competitive and relevant solutions. • Support the delivery of best-in-class enterprise solutions across Arche Global's digital transformation portfolio. Customer Advocacy and Storytelling • Represent the voice of the customer within Arche Global. • Develop and share customer success stories, solution narratives, and transformation outcomes across internal and external channels. • Deliver compelling presentations on strategies, solutions, and initiatives to technical and executive audiences. Key Skills and Competencies: • Strong leadership skills with the ability to drive outcomes in complex and matrixed environments. • Deep expertise in partner ecosystem management across Microsoft, Google, AWS, Cisco, VMware, and related providers. • Strong understanding of cloud, infrastructure, networking, and security solutions. • Proven success in driving enterprise digital transformation initiatives. • Strong experience managing long-term global customer relationships. • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills. • Strong project management capabilities and analytical problem-solving skills. • Ability to think strategically and align technology solutions with business goals. Qualifications and Skillsets: • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field. • MBA preferred. • 15+ years of experience in sales, partner management, or business strategy roles. • Strong experience in cloud solutions, enterprise software, networking, and security. • Familiarity with sales frameworks such as Solution Selling, Miller Heiman, or SPIN. Why Join Us? At Arche Global, we are at the forefront of digital transformation, helping businesses across the globe achieve operational excellence through our innovative technology solutions. As a Senior Account Manager focusing on GCCs, you will play a critical role in shaping our global strategy, building strong partnerships, and driving solutions that create meaningful business impact. If you are a dynamic leader with a passion for technology and transformation, we encourage you to apply. Arche Global Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Senior Account Manager - Digital Transformation (Net New Business)
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Account Manager to drive net new business within the enterprise segment. This role is focused on acquiring new clients, managing strategic relationships, and delivering long-term business growth. This is an individual contributor role that requires strong hunting skills, business acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to manage end-to-end sales cycles in a competitive environment. Qualifications and Skillsets: • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field. • 12 to 15 years of experience in B2B or enterprise IT sales. • Experience selling IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Security, or Managed Services. • Demonstrated success in managing enterprise accounts or closing large strategic deals. title: Account Manager-Travel & Transportation
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are seeking a dynamic Account Manager specialized in the Travel & Transportation sector to develop client relationships, drive business growth, and ensure customer satisfaction through innovative technology solutions. Roles and Responsibilities: Develop and execute strategic sales plans to identify, target, and acquire new clients in the travel & transportation sector. Drive end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure, ensuring revenue targets are met. Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline, ensuring consistent business growth. Develop strong value propositions and tailor solutions to client needs. Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements to maximize profitability. Account Management & Client Retention Manage and grow existing client relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction and retention. Drive upselling and cross-selling of additional products/services to existing accounts. Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts, addressing client queries and concerns proactively. Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to track client performance and explore growth opportunities. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities Results-oriented with proven ability to plan and complete tasks independently Problem-solving skills with attention to detail Time management skills with capacity to prioritize effectively Customer-centric mindset and listening skills Qualifications & Skillsets: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field 4-6 years in B2B sales, business development, or account management within Travel, Transportation, Logistics, or related industries. Strong hunting & farming capabilities, with a proven track record of revenue generation. Experience in solution selling, consultative sales, or enterprise sales. Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Ability to work independently and drive results in a fast-paced environment. Experience with CRM tools and data-driven decision-making.
